id.description: ID for the <table> element. Required for accessibility when using sticky headers or scrollable tables.

columns.description: Column definitions. Each item: { key, header, render, align, sortable, width, pin, primary, hidden, aggregate, footer, className, headerClassName }.

pin.description: Pin the column on horizontal scroll.

primary.description: Marks the primary column shown in stacked/responsive mode.

primaryKey.description: Property name used as the unique row identifier.

scrollable.description: Wrap the table in a horizontally-scrollable container.

responsive.description: Responsive mode: 'stack' or 'stack-header' for mobile stacking behaviour.

stickyHeader.description: Keep the header row visible while scrolling (usa-table--sticky-header).

stickyFirstColumn.description: Sticky-pin the first column on horizontal scroll.

sortable.description: Enable sorting on all columns (individual columns can opt out via column.sortable: false).

sort.description: Controlled sort state: { key: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' | null }.

onSort.description: Callback fired when a column header is clicked: ({ key, direction }) => void.

selectionMode.description: Row selection mode. 'checkbox' enables multi-select; 'radio' enables single-select.

select.description: Controlled array of selected primary key values.

onSelect.description: Callback fired when selection changes: (selectedKeys[]) => void.

allowSelectAll.description: Show 'select all' checkbox in header (checkbox mode only).

disabled.description: Array of primary key values for rows that should be non-interactive.

onClickRow.description: Callback fired when a row is clicked: (rowData, event) => void.

groupBy.description: Group rows by a property. String shorthand or object: { property, expand, onExpand, defaultExpanded }.

rowDetails.description: Enable expandable row detail panels. Function: (row) => ReactNode. Object: { render, expand, onExpand, expandLabel }.

showFooter.description: Render a <tfoot> row using column.footer or column.aggregate values.

paginate.description: Enable pagination. true for client-side; object { pageSize, totalCount, onPageChange } for server-side.

onMore.description: Infinite scroll callback, called when the last row becomes visible.

loading.description: Show a loading state overlay. Does not affect interactivity.

placeholder.description: Content shown when the data array is empty.

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the <table> element.

header_rows.description: Django only. Pre-computed header row structure from table_helper.build_header_rows(columns). Required for rendering; compute in the view and pass as context.

leaf_columns.description: Django only. Flat list of leaf (non-parent) columns from table_helper.get_leaf_cols(columns). Required for body and footer rendering.

total_cols.description: Django only. Total column count including aux columns (selection, detail). From table_helper.total_col_count().

total_depth.description: Django only. Number of header levels; len(header_rows). Required for rowspan calculations.

groups.description: Django only. Pre-grouped data from table_helper.group_data(data, field). Required when groupBy is set.

defaultExpanded.description: Django only. Whether grouped rows start expanded. Defaults to true. Pass false to render all groups collapsed.

footerValues.description: Django only. Pre-computed footer values dict from table_helper.compute_footer(columns, data). Required when showFooter is True.

expandedRows.description: Django only. List of primary-key values whose detail rows are open on initial render. Mirrors the React rowDetails.expand controlled prop.

rowDetailTemplate.description: Django only. Path to a Django partial template rendered as row-detail content (replaces React rowDetails.render).

rowDetailField.description: Django only. Key in each row dict whose value is used as inline row-detail content (simpler alternative to rowDetailTemplate).

rowUrlField.description: Django only. Key in each row dict holding the navigation URL for clickable rows (replaces React onClickRow). The block-link CSS pattern is used; no JS required.

paginateUrlPrefix.description: Django only. URL prefix for pagination page links, forwarded to the pagination sub-template.

pagination.description: Django only. Pagination state dict from table_helper.paginate_table(): {current_page, total_pages, total, page_size}. Required when paginate is True.
